Meta.title: Maison Aurelle
Meta.description: Niche fragrances from Vienna — carefully curated.

Home.editorial1Body: We don't curate trends, we curate character. Every fragrance in our selection tells its own story — beyond the mainstream, but never loud for its own sake.
Home.editorial2Body: Every bottle in our range is personally tested before it earns a place with us. Quality and character over volume.
Home.quote: A great fragrance is the memory you can't see.
Home.newsletterBody: New fragrances, exclusive insights, and invitations to tastings — straight to your inbox.

About.title: About us
About.body: Maison Aurelle stands for carefully curated niche fragrances beyond the mainstream — personally selected, presented in Vienna.
About.storyTitle: Made from an eye for detail
About.storyBody: Maison Aurelle was founded on the belief that a fragrance can be more than an accessory — it can create memories. We travel, smell, and personally select everything that makes it into our collection.
About.value1Body: Every fragrance comes directly from authorized houses — no counterfeits, no detours.
About.value2Body: We don't list everything — only what genuinely convinces us.
About.value3Body: Questions about a fragrance? We're happy to help you choose.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.q1: Are your fragrances original and verified?
Faq.a1: Yes, every fragrance in our collection is 100% original, sourced directly from authorized houses.
Faq.q2: Do you also have a physical store?
Faq.a2: Yes, you can experience our collection in person at our store in Vienna — opening hours and location <link>here</link>.
Faq.q3: Do you offer refunds or returns?
Faq.a3: Unopened items can be returned within 14 days. Details are on the respective product page.
Faq.a4: 2–3 business days within Austria, 4–8 business days internationally depending on destination.
Faq.q5: Which payment methods do you accept?
Faq.a5: Credit card, PayPal, and instant bank transfer. (Demo — no real ordering system.)
